events.title: Roadmap: what comes after the demo
events.summary: Hello. I'm the developer of Grench Boss.Thank you for playing the demo.The demo ends when the ship leaves the rat coast. Here is what comes after that.I'll keep working hard on it. One wishlist each would mean a lot.During Next Fest- Fixes for problems found through bug reports, comments and other feedback, and through playtests with friends. events.title: Demo 0.1.2 update
events.summary: Nobody left feedback on the first day of Next Fest (thank you for stopping by anyway), so I kept playing it myself. 0.1.2 improves the look and sound.Visuals- Part of the art style changed: the messy texture blending is gone, replaced by smooth, clay-like materials- Walls and enemies are easier to tell apart- New HUD option: quick slots with the health bar under them at the bottom centre; more layouts in Settings- Menus and panels reworked; clearer titles and item names- Enemy outlines reworked;

events.title: Greetings from the dev
events.summary: Hello. I'm the developer of Grench Boss.Thank you so much for installing the demo. 🙇This is my first game.I know it still has many rough parts, but I'm learning and getting better little by little.I believe if I keep improving it, someday it will become a pretty good defense game.Any feedback is welcome, in any language you like. Thank you.How to send feedback- Comment on this post- In the game, press F8 to open the report window- Email: contact@induo.works- Discord: https://discord.gg/QZ9BVactG
